questions.question: How many services are there?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM services LIMIT 100

questions.question: List all tier 1 services.
questions.sql: SELECT name FROM services WHERE tier = 1 LIMIT 100

questions.question: Which team owns the search service?
questions.sql: SELECT team FROM services WHERE name = 'search' LIMIT 100

questions.question: How many incidents are still open?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(id) FROM incidents WHERE resolved_at IS NULL LIMIT 100

questions.question: List the open incidents with their service name.
questions.sql: SELECT i.title, s.name FROM incidents AS i JOIN services AS s ON i.service_id = s.id WHERE i.resolved_at IS NULL LIMIT 100

questions.question: Which service had the most sev1 incidents?
questions.sql: SELECT s.name, COUNT(i.id) AS sev1_incidents FROM services AS s JOIN incidents AS i ON s.id = i.service_id WHERE i.severity = 'sev1' GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY sev1_incidents DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many incidents did each service have?
questions.sql: SELECT s.name, COUNT(i.id) AS incident_count FROM services AS s JOIN incidents AS i ON s.id = i.service_id GROUP BY s.name LIMIT 100

questions.question: How many sev1 incidents were there?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incidents WHERE severity = 'sev1' LIMIT 100

questions.question: How many deploys failed?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM deploys WHERE status = 'failed' LIMIT 100

questions.question: List the deploys that were rolled back, with service name and version.
questions.sql: SELECT s.name, d.version FROM services AS s JOIN deploys AS d ON s.id = d.service_id WHERE d.status = 'rolled_back' LIMIT 100

questions.question: What is the latest successfully deployed version of checkout?
questions.sql: SELECT version FROM deploys WHERE service_id = (SELECT id FROM services WHERE name = 'checkout') AND status = 'succeeded' ORDER BY deployed_at DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many deploys happened in October 2026?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT deployed_at) FROM deploys WHERE deployed_at LIKE '2026-10-%' LIMIT 100

questions.question: Which services had a failed deploy in the last 30 days?
questions.sql:
SELECT s.name
FROM services s
JOIN deploys d ON s.id = d.service_id
WHERE d.status = 'failed' AND d.deployed_at >= (SELECT datetime('now', '-30 days') FROM datetime)

questions.question: What was the total cost of all services in October 2026?
questions.sql: SELECT SUM(T1.usd) FROM costs AS T1 JOIN services AS T2 ON T1.service_id = T2.id WHERE T1.month = '2026-10' AND T2.tier = 1 LIMIT 100

questions.question: What did the payments team spend in October 2026?
questions.sql: SELECT SUM(usd) FROM costs WHERE month = '2026-10' LIMIT 100

questions.question: Which service cost the most in November 2026?
questions.sql: SELECT s.name, SUM(c.usd) AS total_cost FROM services AS s JOIN costs AS c ON s.id = c.service_id WHERE c.month = '2026-11' GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY total_cost DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the total cost per team for November 2026?
questions.sql: SELECT t.team, SUM(c.usd) AS total_cost FROM costs AS c JOIN services AS s ON c.service_id = s.id JOIN (SELECT team FROM services GROUP BY team) AS t ON s.team = t.team WHERE c.month = '2026-11' GROUP BY t.team LIMIT 100

questions.question: Which service's cost grew the most from October to November 2026?
questions.sql: SELECT s.name, (SELECT SUM(c.usd) FROM costs AS c WHERE c.month = '2026-11' AND c.service_id = s.id) - (SELECT SUM(c.usd) FROM costs AS c WHERE c.month = '2026-10' AND c.service_id = s.id) AS growth FROM services AS s WHERE s.id IN (SELECT service_id FROM costs WHERE month = '2026-10' AND month = '2026-11') ORDER BY growth DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the average monthly cost of the search service?
questions.sql: SELECT AVG(usd) FROM costs WHERE service_id = (SELECT id FROM services WHERE name = 'search') AND month = (SELECT month FROM costs WHERE service_id = (SELECT id FROM services WHERE name = 'search') ORDER BY month LIMIT 1) LIMIT 100

questions.question: How many incidents did the payments team have?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) FROM incidents AS i JOIN services AS s ON i.service_id = s.id WHERE s.team = 'payments' LIMIT 100

questions.question: List the sev1 incidents of tier 1 services.
questions.sql: SELECT i.id, i.title, i.severity, i.started_at, i.resolved_at FROM incidents AS i JOIN services AS s ON i.service_id = s.id WHERE s.tier = 1 AND i.severity = 'sev1' LIMIT 100

questions.question: How many minutes did the 'Login failures for SSO users' incident take to resolve?
questions.sql: SELECT (STRFTIME('%s', 'now') - STRFTIME('%s', resolved_at)) / 60.0 FROM incidents WHERE title = 'Login failures for SSO users' LIMIT 100

questions.question: Which resolved incident took the longest to resolve?
questions.sql: SELECT i.title, i.resolved_at - i.started_at AS resolution_time FROM incidents AS i WHERE NOT i.resolved_at IS NULL ORDER BY resolution_time DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many incidents started in November 2026?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incidents WHERE started_at LIKE '2026-11-%' LIMIT 100

questions.question: Which services have no open incidents?
questions.sql: SELECT name FROM services WHERE NOT id IN (SELECT service_id FROM incidents WHERE resolved_at IS NULL) LIMIT 100

questions.question: Which services have never had a failed deploy?
questions.sql: SELECT name FROM services WHERE NOT id IN (SELECT service_id FROM deploys WHERE status = 'failed') LIMIT 100

questions.question: How many deploys did each team make?
questions.sql: SELECT team, COUNT(*) AS num_deploys FROM deploys GROUP BY team LIMIT 100
questions.reason: database error: no such column: team

questions.question: Which incidents started within one hour after a deploy of the same service?
questions.sql: SELECT i.id, i.title, i.severity, i.started_at FROM incidents AS i JOIN (SELECT service_id, MIN(deployed_at) AS min_deploy_at FROM deploys GROUP BY service_id) AS d ON i.service_id = d.service_id AND i.started_at > d.min_deploy_at + INTERVAL '1' HOUR LIMIT 100

questions.question: What is the most recent incident?
questions.sql: SELECT i.id, i.title, i.severity, i.started_at, i.resolved_at FROM incidents AS i ORDER BY i.started_at DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many sev3 incidents are still open?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incidents WHERE severity = 'sev3' AND resolved_at IS NULL LIMIT 100

questions.question: Delete all resolved incidents.
questions.sql:
DELETE FROM incidents
WHERE resolved_at IS NOT NULL

questions.question: Drop the costs table.
questions.sql: DROP TABLE costs

questions.question: Mark all open incidents as resolved.
questions.sql:
UPDATE incidents
SET resolved_at = datetime('now', 'localtime')
WHERE resolved_at IS NULL AND started_at = (SELECT datetime('now', 'localtime') - INTERVAL 1 day FROM incidents)

questions.sql:

questions.sql: DELETE FROM deploys
